title: SAE in GPT2 learns about Hungarian Palinka

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed learning about sparse autoencoders in the previous video.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡上一支影片中關於稀疏自編碼器的內容。

cues.en: I'm a big fan of using simulated data to learn about and explore advanced data analysis techniques.
cues.zh: 我很喜歡用模擬資料，來學習與探索進階資料分析技術。

cues.en: For the reasons that I explained in the previous video, but there is no substitute for working with real data.
cues.zh: 原因我在上一支影片解釋過了，但處理真實資料仍然無可取代。

cues.en: There are uncertainties and challenges and other issues that real data force upon you that you can kind of side skirt with simulated data.
cues.zh: 真實資料會帶來一些不確定性、挑戰和其他問題，使用模擬資料時則可以稍微避開。

cues.en: Anyway, so the goal of this video is to show you what's involved in building training and interpreting
cues.zh: 總之，這支影片的目標，是展示建立、訓練與解讀

cues.en: autoencoders with some text that I copied from Wikipedia.
cues.zh: 自編碼器的過程，使用的是我從維基百科複製的一些文字。

cues.en: It's a relatively small amount of text, so we shouldn't really expect a lot of beautiful, clean results from the latent components.
cues.zh: 文字量相對少，所以不應期待潛在成分會呈現很多漂亮、乾淨的結果。

cues.en: But this is still a great opportunity to learn about sparse encoders.
cues.zh: 但這仍是學習稀疏編碼器的好機會。

cues.en: And you're also going to learn about something called Palinka.
cues.zh: 你也會認識一種叫 Pálinka 的東西。

cues.en: There's no new math for this video, so let me jump straight into the overview of the code demo.
cues.zh: 這支影片沒有新的數學內容，所以直接來看程式示範概覽。

cues.en: Here is a screenshot of the Wikipedia page about Palinka.
cues.zh: 這是關於 Pálinka 的維基百科頁面截圖。

cues.en: Palinka is a sweet liquor that's made in several parts of Eastern Europe, in the Balkans, Greece and Turkey, thereabouts.
cues.zh: Pálinka 是一種甜的烈酒，在東歐、巴爾幹半島、希臘、土耳其一帶的幾個地區製造。

cues.en: It's something like a schnapps, and if you are ever in that part of the world, in particular Hungary or Romania, then I can recommend trying a little bit with food.
cues.zh: 有點像 schnapps。如果你到那一帶，尤其是匈牙利或羅馬尼亞，可以試著配餐喝一點。

cues.en: But keep in mind that palinka can be pretty strong, and I definitely do not want to encourage drinking too much of it.
cues.zh: 但記得，Pálinka 可能很烈，我絕對不是要鼓勵你喝太多。

cues.en: Anyway, I have copied a handful of sentences from this wiki page, and that's what we're going to use
cues.zh: 總之，我從這個維基頁面複製了幾個句子，我們會用它們

cues.en: to train MLP neuron activations in a sparse autoencoder.
cues.zh: 產生 MLP 神經元活化，來訓練稀疏自編碼器。

cues.en: Here you see a screenshot of the autoencoder model that I am going to train.
cues.zh: 這裡是我要訓練的自編碼器模型截圖。

cues.en: Now, some of this code you have seen in the previous video, but I've also modified a couple of things here.
cues.zh: 上一支影片中，你已經看過其中一些程式碼，但這裡也修改了幾個地方。

cues.en: For one, you can see that I have commented out the line that creates the decoder and instead down here
cues.zh: 首先，我把建立解碼器的那一行註解掉，改成在下方

cues.en: in the forward method here I multiply the latent layer by the encoder weights transposed.
cues.zh: forward 方法中，讓潛在層乘上編碼器權重的轉置。

cues.en: So that means that the decoder is tied to the encoder.
cues.zh: 這代表解碼器與編碼器共用權重。

cues.en: The main reason I did that was to reduce the total number of parameters that we need to estimate for this model, because we just don't have that much data to train the model.
cues.zh: 主要原因是，訓練模型的資料量不多，所以要減少這個模型需要估計的參數總數。

cues.en: And yeah, you know, if you're doing this for an actual research project, you'd want to use thousands or tens of thousands of tokens for training.
cues.zh: 如果是實際研究專案，會想使用幾千或幾萬個 token 進行訓練。

cues.en: And the texts that I use here, I think is 220 tokens.
cues.zh: 我這裡使用的文字，我想只有 220 個 token。

cues.en: So another added feature to this model is a parameter that here I call k.
cues.zh: 另一個新增的模型功能，是這裡稱為 k 的參數。

cues.en: This is another way to impose sparsity on an autoencoder model.
cues.zh: 這是對自編碼器模型施加稀疏性的另一種方式。

cues.en: So you can see that I define k to be either whatever the input is or to be half of the input dimension
cues.zh: 可以看到，k 會設為輸入指定的值，或者設為輸入維度的一半，

cues.en: which corresponds to the number of tokens that we are processing.
cues.zh: 這個維度對應我們處理的 token 數量。

cues.en: And you can see the impact of this parameter k down here in the forward model.
cues.zh: 在下面的前向模型中，可以看到參數 k 的影響。

cues.en: So what I do is find the k largest activation values.
cues.zh: 我的做法是找出最大的 k 個活化值。

cues.en: And then I zero out any activation that is less than those top values.
cues.zh: 接著，把小於這些最大值的活化歸零。

cues.en: In other words I'm forcing lots of activation values to be zero.
cues.zh: 也就是強制讓很多活化值變成零。

cues.en: So that imposes sparsity.
cues.zh: 這樣就施加了稀疏性。

cues.en: I will give a brief reminder of other parts of the model in the code demo.
cues.zh: 在程式示範中，我會簡短複習模型的其他部分。

cues.en: So when I switch to code.
cues.zh: 也就是切換到程式碼之後。

cues.en: But that's the basics of what I've changed here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡修改的基本內容。

cues.en: So after training I will plot the loss functions.
cues.zh: 訓練之後，我會繪製損失函數。

cues.en: Here you see the total loss, the sparsity loss and also the loss from what I call the decorrelation loss.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到總損失、稀疏性損失，以及我稱為去相關損失的那一項。

cues.en: This is the off diagonal covariance elements that you see down here.
cues.zh: 也就是下方這些非對角的共變異數元素。

cues.en: I explained what this does in the previous video, although I didn't actually use this penalty term in the model in the previous video.
cues.zh: 上一支影片解釋過它的作用，但當時的模型其實沒有使用這個懲罰項。

cues.en: You can see that this penalty term has a big effect in the beginning, and then it basically just does
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個懲罰項在一開始影響很大，然後基本上就是

cues.en: its job by promoting independence among the latent components, and then once it pushes the model in
cues.zh: 藉由促進潛在成分之間的獨立性來發揮作用。一開始把模型往

cues.en: the right direction, initially, it doesn't seem like the penalty term really gets used that much anyway.
cues.zh: 正確方向推進之後，這個懲罰項似乎就不太派得上用場了。

cues.en: So now we have a trained model and we can start investigating what it looks like.
cues.zh: 現在模型已經訓練好，可以開始研究它的樣子。

cues.en: So this plot here on the left shows the percentage of tokens that have non-zero activations from all of the latent components.
cues.zh: 左邊這張圖顯示，所有潛在成分各自有多少百分比的 token 出現非零活化。

cues.en: You can see that there's over 6000 components in the hidden layer, and the total activation matrix is around 6.5% dense.
cues.zh: 隱藏層有超過 6,000 個成分，整個活化矩陣的密度約為 6.5%。

cues.en: Now, this is not the same use of the term density as in sparse logistic regression from several videos ago.
cues.zh: 這裡「密度」的用法，與幾支影片前的稀疏邏輯斯迴歸不同。

cues.en: In that case, with the regression, the density referred to the coefficients of the model, so the beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 在那個迴歸案例中，密度指的是模型係數，也就是 beta 係數。

cues.en: Whereas here.
cues.zh: 而這裡，

cues.en: Now with the autoencoders, I'm using this term density to refer to the number of non-zero activations.
cues.zh: 在自編碼器中，我用密度這個詞來表示非零活化的數量。

cues.en: So this block just shows the percent of tokens that have any activation over here in the middle you can see what the activation values actually are.
cues.zh: 這張圖顯示有活化的 token 百分比，中間則顯示實際的活化值。

cues.en: They're all non-negative values.
cues.zh: 它們全都是非負值。

cues.en: And that's not something that I enforced is something that comes from the top k sparsity selection.
cues.zh: 這並不是我強制設定的，而是 top-k 稀疏選擇所產生的結果。

cues.en: That is to say, I did select for large activations, but I did not select specifically for positive activations.
cues.zh: 也就是說，我確實選擇了較大的活化，但沒有特別限定正活化。

cues.en: That's just how it ended up working out okay.
cues.zh: 結果自然就變成這樣。

cues.en: And then over here is the non-zero activations by the percent of tokens that have any activations.
cues.zh: 右邊則是非零活化與有活化的 token 百分比之間的關係。

cues.en: Of course the y axis values have a floor of zero and a ceiling of 100%.
cues.zh: 當然，y 軸值的下限是零，上限是 100%。

cues.en: So this plot ends up not being super insightful in the sense that it is fairly trivial that the more activations there are, the stronger those activations are going to be.
cues.zh: 所以這張圖最後沒有太多洞見，因為活化越多、活化就越強，這件事相當平凡。

cues.en: But I thought it would be interesting initially, so I plotted it anyway.
cues.zh: 但我一開始覺得可能很有趣，所以還是畫出來了。

cues.en: Okay, so now we have over 6000 latent components.
cues.zh: 好，現在有超過 6,000 個潛在成分。

cues.en: What do we do with them and how do we know which of those 6000 are meaningful to interpret?
cues.zh: 要拿它們做什麼？怎麼知道這 6,000 個中，哪些值得解讀？

cues.en: In the previous video I knew the ground truth, latent sources, so I could simply correlate the ground
cues.zh: 上一支影片中，我知道潛在來源的真值，所以只要計算真值

cues.en: truth data with the latent components and interpret the latent components that correlated best with the simulated data.
cues.zh: 資料與潛在成分的相關性，再解讀那些與模擬資料最相關的潛在成分即可。

cues.en: But we don't have that luxury here because we don't know what the ground truth is.
cues.zh: 但這裡沒有這種優勢，因為我們不知道真值。

cues.en: We actually, you know, we don't know why how the model works.
cues.zh: 我們其實不知道模型為何、如何運作。

cues.en: That's kind of the goal of these analyses.
cues.zh: 那正是這些分析的目標。

cues.en: So instead what we can do is sort the latent components according to some of these metrics for example.
cues.zh: 所以可以改用一些指標，對潛在成分排序。

cues.en: So for example we can find the component that has the most sparsity or the components that have the largest activations.
cues.zh: 例如，找出最稀疏的成分，或者活化最大的成分。

cues.en: I will show a few different ways of sorting and selecting components in the code.
cues.zh: 我會在程式碼中展示幾種排序與選擇成分的方法。

cues.en: Here you see heatmaps of text heatmap of activations for one of the components, and this one I selected based on having strong activations.
cues.zh: 這裡是其中一個成分的文字活化熱圖，我是根據活化強度選出它的。

cues.en: Now if you look through the text at what gets highlighted the strongest, you can see that this latent component seems to be selecting for something about geographical regions.
cues.zh: 如果看看文字中哪些地方被突顯得最強，會發現這個潛在成分似乎在選擇與地理區域有關的東西。

cues.en: So words like Hungary, Hungary, Romania, Transylvania, Italy, regions, Hungary, Greece, Slovakia, provinces, Austria, regions and so on.
cues.zh: 例如匈牙利、匈牙利、羅馬尼亞、外西凡尼亞、義大利、地區、匈牙利、希臘、斯洛伐克、省分、奧地利、地區等等。

cues.en: So it does seem to get a lot of strong activations for countries, geographical regions, regions, but it certainly doesn't activate exclusively to geographical regions.
cues.zh: 它似乎確實會對國家、地理區域產生很多強活化，但絕對不只對地理區域活化。

cues.en: For example, you also see some activation to a period and another period here, and local variations and so on.
cues.zh: 例如，也可以看到句點、這裡另一個句點，以及地方變體等詞的活化。

cues.en: But actually inspired by results like this, I decided to create what I called a geography score.
cues.zh: 不過，受到這類結果啟發，我決定建立一個稱為地理分數的指標。

cues.en: That is, the average of the activations to the geography tokens divided by the average of the activations to all of the other tokens.
cues.zh: 也就是地理 token 的平均活化，除以所有其他 token 的平均活化。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是那個分數。

cues.en: So a value of one would mean that the latent component has an equal amount of activation for geography
cues.zh: 值為 1，表示潛在成分對地理

cues.en: and non geography tokens and values above one mean that the model is more active for geography tokens than non geography tokens.
cues.zh: 與非地理 token 的活化量相同；大於 1，表示模型對地理 token 的活化高於非地理 token。

cues.en: Of course on average average across all 220 of these tokens.
cues.zh: 當然，這是對全部 220 個 token 取平均。

cues.en: And of course there's lots of zeros down here because there's a lot of sparsity.
cues.zh: 下面有很多零，因為稀疏性很高。

cues.en: Now I think this is a pretty interesting approach to picking out a component.
cues.zh: 我覺得，這是挑選成分的相當有趣的方法。

cues.en: Although as I'll show you in the code, it turned out to be not as clean as we might like, but I suspect
cues.zh: 但如同稍後在程式碼中展示的，結果沒有我們希望的那麼乾淨。我懷疑，

cues.en: that's due to the very small amount of data that we used for training and for calculating this score, and of course, for training the autoencoder model.
cues.zh: 這是因為我們用來計算分數的資料量很少，當然，訓練自編碼器的資料也很少。

cues.en: Anyway, lots of interesting things to explore.
cues.zh: 總之，有很多有趣的東西值得探索。

cues.en: So I will now switch to Python Several libraries that we will need here.
cues.zh: 現在切換到 Python。這裡有我們需要的幾個函式庫。

cues.en: And we definitely want to use the GPU for because we're training this model, the autoencoder model,
cues.zh: 我們一定要使用 GPU，因為要訓練這個自編碼器模型，

cues.en: and it's pretty big, considerably bigger than the autoencoder model in the previous video and in the code challenge in the next video.
cues.zh: 而且它很大，比上一支影片和下一支程式挑戰中的自編碼器大上許多。

cues.en: We really, really want to use a GPU.
cues.zh: 真的非常需要 GPU。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then here I import the GPT two, uh, the model and the tokenizer.
cues.zh: 這裡匯入 GPT2 模型和 tokenizer。

cues.en: And here I'm setting up a hook to grab the MLP activations.
cues.zh: 這裡設定 hook，擷取 MLP 活化。

cues.en: I get it from the fully connected layer before it goes through the jlu non-linearity.
cues.zh: 我從全連接層擷取，也就是通過 GELU 非線性函數之前。

cues.en: The hook function is very simple because yeah, in this demo file I'm only going to hook one layer.
cues.zh: hook 函數非常簡單，因為這個示範檔只會掛接一層。

cues.en: In the next video, we will hook all of the layers, which we've done multiple times before.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會掛接所有層，這件事我們以前已經做過很多次了。

cues.en: And here's something that I haven't done in a while, which is grab an output of this, uh, register forward hook method on this model component.
cues.zh: 這裡有個很久沒做的操作：取得這個模型元件的 register_forward_hook 方法傳回的值。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm doing this is because I'm going to delete this hook function.
cues.zh: 這樣做的原因，是我之後要刪除這個 hook 函數。

cues.en: So I'm going to use this handle to remove this function from the model.
cues.zh: 我要用這個 handle，把函數從模型中移除。

cues.en: We actually do not need to do that in this case.
cues.zh: 這個例子其實不需要這樣做。

cues.en: But I'm just doing it as a reminder of how that works in case you need to use it in the future.
cues.zh: 我只是藉此提醒你它的用法，以後需要時可以使用。

cues.en: As you know, I typically do not do this because yeah, typically don't need to.
cues.zh: 你知道，我通常不會這樣做，因為通常沒有必要。

cues.en: But yeah, just thought I'd be give you a little reminder of that.
cues.zh: 只是想稍微提醒你一下。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here we have text again.
cues.zh: 這裡又是文字。

cues.en: This is just copy pasted from this Wikipedia page which you can read further if you'd like to learn more about Palinka.
cues.zh: 這只是從維基百科頁面複製貼上的；如果想更了解 Pálinka，可以進一步閱讀。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So yeah there are 220 tokens in total here.
cues.zh: 這裡總共有 220 個 token。

cues.en: I'm pushing the tokens through the model and here I am removing the hook.
cues.zh: 我讓 token 通過模型，再在這裡移除 hook。

cues.en: Again.
cues.zh: 再說一次，

cues.en: This is not necessary uh, for this video, but yeah, just a nice little reminder.
cues.zh: 這支影片其實不需要這樣做，只是順便提醒一下。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then I grab the MLP activations, just printing out the size.
cues.zh: 接著取得 MLP 活化，這裡只是印出大小。

cues.en: And then I push those to the GPU.
cues.zh: 然後把它們移到 GPU。

cues.en: And why am I pushing these to the GPU?
cues.zh: 為什麼要把這些移到 GPU？

cues.en: Because these are the MLP activations that I am going to use to train the auto encoder model.
cues.zh: 因為這些 MLP 活化，就是我要用來訓練自編碼器模型的資料。

cues.en: So the auto encoder will take these data as inputs and then do some fancy magical auto encoding stuff.
cues.zh: 自編碼器會把這些資料當成輸入，進行一些花俏、神奇的自編碼操作。

cues.en: Of course it's not magic, but you know, gradient descent and etc. etc. and then produce an output that will initially be just some random transformation of the input.
cues.zh: 當然，不是魔法，而是梯度下降等等。接著產生輸出，一開始只是輸入的某種隨機轉換。

cues.en: And then through gradient descent, the autoencoder will try to find a set of sparse transformations
cues.zh: 然後，透過梯度下降，自編碼器會嘗試找出一組稀疏轉換，

cues.en: that gets the output of the autoencoder to look like these MLP activations as closely as possible.
cues.zh: 讓自編碼器輸出盡可能接近這些 MLP 活化。

cues.en: Okay, here is the code where I create the autoencoder.
cues.zh: 好，這是建立自編碼器的程式碼。

cues.en: So let me see.
cues.zh: 讓我看看。

cues.en: I just want to highlight a couple of things.
cues.zh: 我只想強調幾件事。

cues.en: So first of all about the decoder.
cues.zh: 首先是解碼器。

cues.en: So yeah here instead of pushing this the output of the latent layer through a separate decoder set of
cues.zh: 這裡不再讓潛在層輸出通過另一組需要由模型訓練的

cues.en: weights that would need to be trained by the model, I'm using the transpose of the encoder weights
cues.zh: 解碼器權重，而是使用編碼器權重的轉置，

cues.en: and multiplying those by the output of the latent layer, which is what we get from here.
cues.zh: 讓它乘上潛在層的輸出，也就是這裡得到的東西。

cues.en: Again, this is a choice.
cues.zh: 再說一次，這是一種選擇。

cues.en: There is no real right or wrong.
cues.zh: 並沒有絕對的對錯。

cues.en: But in general, if you don't have a huge amount of data to train the autoencoder, then it's often
cues.zh: 但一般來說，如果沒有大量資料可以訓練自編碼器，

cues.en: beneficial to tie the weights because it means that you are reducing the number of parameters that the
cues.zh: 共用權重通常有好處，因為這樣會減少模型需要

cues.en: model needs to learn through gradient descent, and that is the primary reason why I did it here.

cues.en: Okay, so here's this parameter k.
cues.zh: 好，這裡是參數 k。

cues.en: I've already described it in the slides as a quick reminder.
cues.zh: 投影片已經介紹過，快速複習一下。

cues.en: It determines the sparsity of the activations.
cues.zh: 它決定活化的稀疏程度。

cues.en: So k is either a parameter that we can provide as input or by default it will just take half of the input.
cues.zh: k 可以是我們透過輸入提供的參數，預設則取輸入的一半。

cues.en: And what does this mean.
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思？

cues.en: This means that for example if we set this to be 0.5, so 50% of the input dimension of the 220 tokens,
cues.zh: 例如，如果設成 0.5，也就是 220 個 token 輸入維度的 50%，

cues.en: 110 of them will be zeroed out, the smallest activations will get zeroed out, and that will promote sparsity.
cues.zh: 其中 110 個就會被歸零，最小的活化會被歸零，這樣便促進稀疏性。

cues.en: That is going to force the model to learn a sparse representation of the data, as opposed to an overcomplete and redundant representation of the data.
cues.zh: 這會強制模型學習資料的稀疏表徵，而非過完備、具有冗餘的表徵。

cues.en: So again, you know, that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡看到的內容。

cues.en: So here's the forward model.
cues.zh: 這是前向模型。

cues.en: I take the input data which are the MLP activations from one layer.

cues.en: Push it through the encoder.

cues.zh: 也就是前面這裡，接著套用非線性函數。我想，上一支影片用 GELU，這裡用 ReLU。

cues.en: There's uh for very large models like language models.
cues.zh: 對於語言模型這類很大的模型，

cues.en: It does seem to be the case that the Jlu non-linearity outperforms ReLU non-linearity.

cues.en: It's not really clear if, uh, there is much of an advantage for smaller models.
cues.zh: 對較小模型而言，是否有明顯優勢就不太清楚。

cues.en: And furthermore, ReLU is a little bit better than jlu at promoting sparsity.
cues.zh: 此外，ReLU 比 GELU 更能促進稀疏性。

cues.en: And why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because remember that all of the negative activation values get completely obliterated.
cues.zh: 因為記得，所有負活化值都會被完全消除。

cues.en: They all turn to zero with ReLU.
cues.zh: 通過 ReLU 後，全都變成零。

cues.en: Whereas with Gelu there actually is a little bit of a negative pass in the filter, which means that with the ReLU activation you do get negative numbers.
cues.zh: 而 GELU 的濾波器其實會讓少量負值通過，也就是說，使用 ReLU 活化時確實會得到負數。

cues.en: They're just, you know, numerically closer to zero versus the original values that you pass in through.
cues.zh: 只是數值比原先傳入

cues.en: Gelu.
cues.zh: GELU 的值更接近零。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: So ReLU promotes sparsity a little bit better than Gelu.
cues.zh: 所以 ReLU 比 GELU 稍微更能促進稀疏性。

cues.en: And sparsity is something that we are looking for in these kinds of models.
cues.zh: 而稀疏性正是我們在這類模型中追求的特性。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here I take all of the activations.
cues.zh: 這裡我取出所有活化。

cues.en: So these are the latent component activations I find the top k which is this parameter I just discussed.
cues.zh: 也就是潛在成分活化，找出 top-k，k 就是剛才討論的參數。

cues.en: And then I find the smallest of the top k values.
cues.zh: 然後找出 top-k 數值中最小的一個。

cues.en: So the largest let's say 100 tokens.
cues.zh: 也就是最大的，比方說 100 個 token。

cues.en: And then I find the smallest of the largest tokens.
cues.zh: 接著，在最大的那些 token 中找出最小值。

cues.en: And then I create this mask here.
cues.zh: 然後建立這個遮罩。

cues.en: And I say where is any of the activations anywhere from any component and any token.
cues.zh: 我問的是：任何成分、任何 token 的活化中，

cues.en: Where are those less than or in this case, greater than the threshold and those end up being ones.
cues.zh: 哪些小於，或者這裡其實是大於門檻？那些位置最後會是 1。

cues.en: And here I multiply that by this latent here.
cues.zh: 接著，把它乘上這裡的 latent。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what does that mean.
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: That means that I am preserving the strongest K activations and wiping out all the other activations.
cues.zh: 代表保留最強的 k 個活化，清除其他所有活化。

cues.en: But I'm not specifically saying which activations those are or which tokens they could be in or which components they can be in.
cues.zh: 但我沒有指定是哪些活化，也沒有指定它們來自哪些 token 或哪些成分。

cues.en: So that is driven by the activation patterns in the model.
cues.zh: 這完全由模型中的活化模式決定。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then we have the sparsity loss.
cues.zh: 接著是稀疏性損失。

cues.en: This I've already explained several times.
cues.zh: 這已經解釋過好幾次。

cues.en: Here is the covariance penalty term which I described and walk through the code for in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是共變異數懲罰項，上一支影片已經說明並逐步介紹過程式碼。

cues.en: So just as a quick reminder here, I look at the covariance across all of the latent components.
cues.zh: 快速複習一下，我在這裡查看所有潛在成分之間的共變異數。

cues.en: This tells me about the correlation patterns across the different pairs of components.
cues.zh: 這能告訴我不同成分配對之間的相關模式。

cues.en: And then here I'm zeroing out the diagonal and then I just square the off diagonal elements.
cues.zh: 這裡把對角元素歸零，再將非對角元素平方。

cues.en: The squaring is partly just to get rid of the negative covariances.
cues.zh: 平方的一部分目的，只是要消除負共變異數。

cues.en: So essentially what this is doing is removing all of the or like mildly suppressing any of the relationships,
cues.zh: 所以，這基本上是在移除所有關係，或者說，輕微抑制

cues.en: the linear relationships across the different components.
cues.zh: 不同成分之間的線性關係。

cues.en: And what that does is help the model learn that the latent components should be independent of each other.
cues.zh: 這有助於讓模型學到，潛在成分應該彼此獨立。

cues.en: Okay, so that's that.

cues.zh: 做前向傳播。

cues.en: We get the different loss terms.
cues.zh: 取得各個損失項。

cues.en: So the L1 sparsity loss the decorrelation loss and then the MSE loss plus the L1 plus the decorrelation
cues.zh: 也就是 L1 稀疏性損失、去相關損失，以及 MSE 損失加上 L1，再加上去相關

cues.en: loss.
cues.zh: 損失。

cues.zh: 這就是這裡的總損失。

cues.en: And then here I do backprop based on the total loss.

cues.zh: 好，現在可以看到，潛在層活化的形狀是 220，對應 token，以及 6144，對應

And here are the 220 tokens.

cues.en: So I start with this density mask.
cues.zh: 先建立這個密度遮罩。

cues.en: This is a matrix of the same size as the latent activations.

cues.en: So tokens by components.
cues.zh: 也就是 token 乘上成分。

cues.en: And then I fill it in with a bunch of Nans.
cues.zh: 然後，把它填滿 NaN。

cues.en: And then what I do is replace any of the elements in this density mask with a value of one if they have
cues.zh: 接著，如果某個元素有非零的潛在活化，

cues.en: a non-zero latent activation.
cues.zh: 我就把密度遮罩對應的元素改成 1。

cues.en: So if there's any activation, then that becomes a one, and the rest of these values in here become Nan.

cues.en: So that is handy because I can use this function Nan sum.
cues.zh: 這很方便，因為可以使用 nansum 函數。

cues.en: So now I'm summing down all of the tokens for every component.

cues.en: Then its value here would be zero.

cues.en: Maybe this component responds with some non-zero activations to literally every single token.

cues.en: So all 220 tokens, it had non-zero activation.

cues.en: And so its score in this vector will be 100 for 100% of the tokens got some non-zero activation.
cues.zh: 那它在這個向量中的分數就是 100，代表 100% 的 token 都有非零活化。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then so this is just the proportion or the percentage of tokens that had some activation.
cues.zh: 所以，這只是有活化的 token 所占比例或百分比。

cues.en: We don't actually know from this vector what the activations were.
cues.zh: 光從這個向量，我們其實不知道活化是多少。

cues.en: And that is what I do here.
cues.zh: 這就是我在這裡要做的。

cues.en: So here I take the average of latent component times the density matrix.

cues.en: And this is going to tell me of those non-zero components.
cues.zh: 這會告訴我，在那些非零成分中，

cues.en: What was the average magnitude of the activation.

cues.en: And I'm taking the average because or the absolute value before I take the average.
